BEGIN
  DECLARE current_watermark_micros INT64;
  DECLARE current_watermark_ts TIMESTAMP;
  DECLARE max_available_timestamp TIMESTAMP;
  DECLARE max_closed_timestamp TIMESTAMP;

  -- 1. Check if production table exists; if not, create shell table
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM `test-project.mock_da2_scan_prod.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES`
    WHERE table_name = 'update_history_creates'
  ) THEN
    CREATE TABLE `test-project.mock_da2_scan_prod.update_history_creates`
    PARTITION BY record_date AS
    SELECT
      staging.`history_id`,
      staging.`row_id`,
      staging.`ingested_at`,
      staging.`event_id`,
      staging.`update_row_id`,
      staging.`contract_id`,
      staging.`created_at`,
      staging.`template_id_package_id`,
      staging.`template_id_module_name`,
      staging.`template_id_entity_name`,
      staging.`package_name`,
      staging.`create_arguments`,
      staging.`signatories`,
      staging.`observers`,
      staging.`contract_key`,
      staging.`record_time`,
      staging.`update_id`,
      staging.`domain_id`,
      staging.`migration_id`,
      staging.`datastream_metadata`,
      CAST(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(staging.record_time) AS DATE) AS record_date
    FROM `test-project.mock_da2_scan_staging.scan_sv_1_update_history_creates` AS staging
    WHERE 1 = 0;
  END IF;

  -- 1a. Check that production has every listed column
  CALL `test-project.mock_da2_scan_prod.sp_check_prod_schema`('scan_sv_1_update_history_creates', 'update_history_creates', ['history_id', 'row_id', 'ingested_at', 'event_id', 'update_row_id', 'contract_id', 'created_at', 'template_id_package_id', 'template_id_module_name', 'template_id_entity_name', 'package_name', 'create_arguments', 'signatories', 'observers', 'contract_key', 'record_time', 'update_id', 'domain_id', 'migration_id', 'datastream_metadata']);

  -- 2. Create central watermark tracking table using INT64 (microseconds)
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `test-project.mock_da2_scan_prod.pipeline_watermarks` (
    table_name STRING,
    last_watermark_time INT64
  );

  -- 3. Initialize watermark to epoch zero (0 micros) if missing
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM `test-project.mock_da2_scan_prod.pipeline_watermarks` 
    WHERE table_name = 'update_history_creates'
  ) THEN
    INSERT INTO `test-project.mock_da2_scan_prod.pipeline_watermarks` 
    VALUES ('update_history_creates', 0);
  END IF;

  -- 4. Get current scalar watermark in INT64 micros and convert to TIMESTAMP
  SET current_watermark_micros = (
    SELECT MAX(last_watermark_time) 
    FROM `test-project.mock_da2_scan_prod.pipeline_watermarks` 
    WHERE table_name = 'update_history_creates'
  );

  SET current_watermark_ts = TIMESTAMP_MICROS(current_watermark_micros);

  -- 5. Fetch max available timestamp from staging WITH PARTITION PRUNING
  SET max_available_timestamp = COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT MAX(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(staging.record_time)) 
      FROM `test-project.mock_da2_scan_staging.scan_sv_1_update_history_creates` AS staging
      WHERE (
          staging._PARTITIONTIME >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(current_watermark_ts, INTERVAL 3 HOUR)
          OR staging._PARTITIONTIME IS NULL
        )
    ),
    -- Fall back to current_watermark_ts if no new data arrived in the last 3 hours
    current_watermark_ts
  );

  -- Subtract 1 hour to safely close the ingestion window
  SET max_closed_timestamp = TIMESTAMP_SUB(max_available_timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR);

  -- 6. Filter incremental data with Primary Key Deduplication & Partition Pruning
  CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_incremental AS (
    SELECT
      staging.`history_id`,
      staging.`row_id`,
      staging.`ingested_at`,
      staging.`event_id`,
      staging.`update_row_id`,
      staging.`contract_id`,
      staging.`created_at`,
      staging.`template_id_package_id`,
      staging.`template_id_module_name`,
      staging.`template_id_entity_name`,
      staging.`package_name`,
      staging.`create_arguments`,
      staging.`signatories`,
      staging.`observers`,
      staging.`contract_key`,
      staging.`record_time`,
      staging.`update_id`,
      staging.`domain_id`,
      staging.`migration_id`,
      staging.`datastream_metadata`,
      CAST(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(staging.record_time) AS DATE) AS record_date
    FROM `test-project.mock_da2_scan_staging.scan_sv_1_update_history_creates` AS staging
    WHERE (
        -- Cost control: Scan 3-hour partition window
        staging._PARTITIONTIME >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(current_watermark_ts, INTERVAL 3 HOUR)
        -- Streaming buffer protection for recent arrivals
        OR staging._PARTITIONTIME IS NULL
      )
      AND TIMESTAMP_MICROS(staging.record_time) > current_watermark_ts
      AND TIMESTAMP_MICROS(staging.record_time) <= max_closed_timestamp
    -- Primary Key Deduplication
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY row_id
      ORDER BY 
        staging.datastream_metadata.source_timestamp DESC,
        staging.datastream_metadata.change_sequence_number DESC
    ) = 1
  );

  -- 7. Perform append and update watermark if valid new records exist
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM temp_incremental) THEN
    
    -- by column name: columns added to production since it was
    -- created come after record_date
    INSERT INTO `test-project.mock_da2_scan_prod.update_history_creates` (
      `history_id`,
      `row_id`,
      `ingested_at`,
      `event_id`,
      `update_row_id`,
      `contract_id`,
      `created_at`,
      `template_id_package_id`,
      `template_id_module_name`,
      `template_id_entity_name`,
      `package_name`,
      `create_arguments`,
      `signatories`,
      `observers`,
      `contract_key`,
      `record_time`,
      `update_id`,
      `domain_id`,
      `migration_id`,
      `datastream_metadata`,
      record_date
    )
    SELECT
      `history_id`,
      `row_id`,
      `ingested_at`,
      `event_id`,
      `update_row_id`,
      `contract_id`,
      `created_at`,
      `template_id_package_id`,
      `template_id_module_name`,
      `template_id_entity_name`,
      `package_name`,
      `create_arguments`,
      `signatories`,
      `observers`,
      `contract_key`,
      `record_time`,
      `update_id`,
      `domain_id`,
      `migration_id`,
      `datastream_metadata`,
      record_date
    FROM temp_incremental;

    UPDATE `test-project.mock_da2_scan_prod.pipeline_watermarks`
    SET last_watermark_time = UNIX_MICROS(max_closed_timestamp)
    WHERE table_name = 'update_history_creates'
    AND last_watermark_time < UNIX_MICROS(max_closed_timestamp);

  END IF;
END;
